verdict.rationale: A government filing portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks inside the product. The documented interfaces are PDF forms, upload/fax/mail, fee calculators and a CAPTCHA-gated filing page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
